mapper.select: SELECT p.course_id, pc.title AS course_title, p.prereq_id, pr.title AS prereq_title FROM prereq p JOIN course pc ON p.course_id = pc.course_id JOIN course pr ON p.prereq_id = pr.course_id ORDER BY p.course_id, p.prereq_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prereq WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND prereq_id = #{prereqId}
